texts: Welcome to Quiz Rush! The lights are on! Forty famous cities, photographed at night. Can you recognise them in the dark? You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
Kick-off! Here's your first city. Any idea?
Yes! It's New York. Manhattan's skyline has more than a hundred skyscrapers.
Take a good look. Which city is this?
That's Paris. The Eiffel Tower sparkles for five minutes every hour after dark.
Easy one... or is it? Name this city!
It's London. The Thames runs right through the heart of the city.
Eyes on the screen. What city do we have here?
Correct answer: Dubai. Home of the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world.
You've seen this one before. Which city?
Of course, it's Tokyo. Greater Tokyo is the most populated metropolitan area in the world.
Quick! Which city is this?
Boom! It's Hong Kong. It has more skyscrapers than any other city.
Trust your instinct. Name it!
Here it is: Sydney. The Opera House and the Harbour Bridge light up the harbour.
Don't overthink it. Which city is this?
You got it, it's Las Vegas. The Strip is one of the brightest places on Earth seen from space.
This one is a classic. Which city?
Spot on! It's Venice. The city is built on more than a hundred small islands.
Last easy one! Which city is this?
The answer is Singapore. Marina Bay Sands has a huge infinity pool on its roof.
Medium round! Things get trickier. Which city is this?
Yes! It's Shanghai. The Oriental Pearl Tower stands out on the city's skyline.
Look closely at the details. Which city?
That's Chicago. The world's first skyscraper was built here in 1885.
Ten seconds on the clock. Name this city!
It's Istanbul. The city spreads across two continents, Europe and Asia.
This one fools a lot of people. Which city is it?
Correct answer: Rio de Janeiro. Christ the Redeemer overlooks the city from Corcovado mountain.
Can you get this one right? Which city?
Of course, it's Toronto. The CN Tower was the world's tallest free-standing structure for over 30 years.
Think carefully. What city is this?
Boom! It's San Francisco. The Golden Gate Bridge opened in 1937.
Here's a tricky one. Name it!
Here it is: Moscow. Red Square and the Kremlin are at the heart of the city.
Got it already? Which city is this?
You got it, it's Barcelona. Its famous Sagrada Familia has been under construction since 1882.
Keep that streak going! Which city?
Spot on! It's Seoul. Around half of South Korea's population lives in the Seoul area.
Last medium question! Which city is this?
The answer is Kuala Lumpur. The Petronas Towers were the tallest buildings in the world from 1998 to 2004.
Hard round! Only the experts from here. Which city is this?
Yes! It's Budapest. The Parliament building glows over the Danube river.
Not so easy now. Which city?
That's Prague. Its Charles Bridge dates back to the 14th century.
Here's one for the experts. Name this city!
It's Doha. Qatar's capital hosted the 2022 World Cup final nearby.
Take your time... but not too much. Which city?
Correct answer: Bangkok. Its full ceremonial name is one of the longest place names in the world.
This one is a real head-scratcher. Which city is it?
Of course, it's Cape Town. Table Mountain rises right behind the city.
Big brain time! What city is this?
Boom! It's Vancouver. The city sits between the mountains and the Pacific Ocean.
Lock in your answer! Which city?
Here it is: Lisbon. Its red suspension bridge looks a lot like the Golden Gate.
Few people get this one. Do you?
You got it, it's Taipei. Taipei 101 was the world's tallest building from 2004 to 2010.
Are you still with me? Which city is this?
Spot on! It's Mexico City. The city was built on the ruins of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlan.
Last hard one! Which city?
The answer is Buenos Aires. Its tall white Obelisk stands on one of the widest avenues in the world.
Genius round! Only true masters get these. Which city is this?
Yes! It's Baku. Its three Flame Towers light up like giant flames at night.
Seriously tough now. Name this city!
That's Ljubljana. Its castle sits on a hill above the old town.
If you know this one, you're a legend. Which city?
It's Valletta. Malta's capital is one of the smallest capitals in Europe.
Deep cut! Which city is this?
Correct answer: Tbilisi. The glass Bridge of Peace crosses the Kura river.
Here's a rare one. What is it?
Of course, it's Almaty. Kazakhstan's biggest city sits below snowy mountains.
No hints this time. Which city?
Boom! It's Panama City. It is one of the few capital cities with a rainforest inside its limits.
Almost there! Which city is this?
Here it is: Kuwait City. The Kuwait Towers are the symbol of the city.
Only a handful of people will get this. Which city?
You got it, it's Brisbane. The Story Bridge lights up over the Brisbane River.
Second to last! Name this city!
Spot on! It's Frankfurt. Its skyline earned it the nickname Mainhattan.
Final question! Make it count. Which city is this?
The answer is Montevideo. Uruguay's capital is home to nearly half the country's people.
Lights out, that's the end! How many cities did you recognise? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
